HOW TO USE

用法·How to use

Every drill page works the same way.
ONE
EXAMPLE on the left.
The left cell is already drawn. Read the density, the angle, the weight — that is the target.
TWO
YOURS on the right.
Match it in the empty cell. One pen, one opacity. A firm brush at 100% opacity keeps the value honest.
THREE
Repeat as often as you like.
Duplicate any page to repeat a drill. Nothing in this book is dated, so it never expires.
EXAMPLE
YOURS
